description: Generate hash sums — Produces a hash sum listing for files under the given path using the requested hash algorithm.

_async.description: Run the command asynchronously. Returns a job id immediately.

_group.description: Assign the request to a custom stats group.

base64.description: Set to true to emit hash values in base64 rather than hexadecimal.

download.description: Set to true to force reading the data instead of using remote checksums.

fs.description: Remote name or path to hash, such as `drive:` or `/`.

hashType.description: Hash algorithm to use, e.g. `md5`, `sha1`, or another supported name.

name: operations_hashsum
